import Shared
import SwiftUI

/// Temporary, CI only: shows the Assist recording screen in the state named by the `AssistSnapshot`
/// launch argument (`tap-0`, `release-60`, …) so the screen can be captured with `simctl`.
struct WatchAssistSnapshotRoot: View {
    var body: some View {
        if let scenario = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "AssistSnapshot") {
            WatchAssistSnapshotScreen(scenario: scenario)
        } else {
            WatchHomeView()
        }
    }
}

private struct WatchAssistSnapshotScreen: View {
    let scenario: String
    @State private var viewModel = WatchAssistSnapshotScreen.makeViewModel()

    var body: some View {
        WatchAssistView(viewModel: viewModel)
            .environment(\.assistOrbFixedTime, 0)
            .task {
                // After the screen's own appearance work, which starts a (fake) recording.
                try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 1_500_000_000)
                apply()
            }
    }

    private func apply() {
        let parts = scenario.split(separator: "-")
        viewModel.assistService.deviceReachable = true
        viewModel.recordingSubmission = parts.first == "release" ? .release : .tap
        viewModel.audioLevel = (parts.count > 1 ? Double(parts[1]) ?? 0 : 0) / 100
        viewModel.state = .recording
    }

    private static func makeViewModel() -> WatchAssistViewModel {
        let viewModel = WatchAssistViewModel(
            assistService: WatchAssistService(serverId: "snapshot", pipelineId: "snapshot"),
            audioRecorder: SnapshotRecorder(),
            audioPlayer: AudioPlayer(),
            immediateCommunicatorService: ImmediateCommunicatorService()
        )
        viewModel.chatItems = [
            .init(content: "Turn on the kitchen lights", itemType: .input),
            .init(content: "Done, 3 lights are now on.", itemType: .output),
        ]
        viewModel.assistService.deviceReachable = true
        return viewModel
    }
}

private final class SnapshotRecorder: ObservableObject, WatchAudioRecorderProtocol {
    weak var delegate: WatchAudioRecorderDelegate?

    func startRecording() {}

    func stopRecording() {}

    func cancelRecording() {}
}
